example_32.justification: The Role 'monitoring-role-manager' in the monitoring namespace has the verb 'escalate', which is not a standard Kubernetes verb and could be indicative of custom logic that allows privilege escalation. This role is bound to the service account 'prometheus-sa'. Additionally, there is another Role 'monitoring-namespace-admin' that grants full administrative access within the same namespace. If the 'escalate' verb is misused or exploited, it could potentially allow the 'prometheus-sa' to gain administrative privileges.

example_91.justification: The cluster role 'rolebinding-manager' does not grant permissions to bind to the specific RoleBinding 'namespace-admin-binding'. The OPA Gatekeeper policy mentioned in the annotations of the ClusterRole effectively blocks any escalation path involving binding to 'namespace-admin-binding'.

example_103.justification: The ClusterRole 'monitoring-configmap-reader' is intended to grant read-only access to configmaps within the monitoring namespace only, but it is bound cluster-wide via a ClusterRoleBinding. This means that members of the 'monitoring-team' group have read-only access to all configmaps in the entire cluster, not just within the monitoring namespace.
